question.text: In the Hemant Ghai case (Case 8.4), what was the total proceeds earned through the trades examined during the relevant period?

explanation.text: The Logic: The case facts state that proceeds amounted to Rs. 2.95 crore through the limited trades examined during the relevant period. The Trap: The Rs. 1.95 crore, Rs. 3.95 crore, and Rs. 4.95 crore figures are not the proceeds amount stated in the case; the figure to remember is Rs. 2.95 crore. Note: The Rs. 2.95 crore figure is stated in respect of the limited trades examined during the relevant period, as recorded in the checked Series III-A workbook page.
